zh: 固定套装数量z之后，剩下的只需要用单件补足各自的缺口：A补max(0,x−z)个，B补max(0,y−z)个，总费用是z的函数。
这个费用函数关于z分段线性，转折点只在z=x和z=y处，而z超过max(x,y)只会多花钱；线性段的最小值一定在端点处取得。
只需计算z=0、z=min(x,y)、z=max(x,y)三种情况下的费用z·costAB+max(0,x−z)·costA+max(0,y−z)·costB，取最小值。数值可达约2×10^18，使用64位整数。
en: Once the number of bundles z is fixed, the rest only needs single items to cover each shortfall: max(0,x−z) of A and max(0,y−z) of B, so the total cost is a function of z.
This cost is piecewise linear in z with breakpoints only at z=x and z=y, and going beyond max(x,y) only costs more; a linear piece reaches its minimum at an endpoint.
Just compute the cost z·costAB + max(0,x−z)·costA + max(0,y−z)·costB for z=0, z=min(x,y) and z=max(x,y), and take the minimum. Values can reach about 2×10^18, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate bundle counts 0, min(x,y) and max(x,y), make up the missing single items for each, and take the minimum cost.

## Proof of correctness

After fixing the bundle count z, single items only need to cover each shortfall. The total cost is a piecewise linear function of z whose only breakpoints are x and y, and buying beyond max(x,y) only increases the cost. The minimum of each linear piece is at an endpoint, so the three candidates cover the optimum.

## Complexity

Time O(1), space O(1), using 64-bit integers.
